outcome: Acute myeloid leukemia (AML) (initial genetic testing suggestion)
cohort: Neonates diagnosed with T21 mosaicism and Transient Abnormal Myelopoiesis (TAM), including one specific case and 25 cases identified from a literature review.
finding: T21 mosaicism apparently isolated to the bone marrow is unlikely to be associated with systemic or neurodevelopmental manifestations of Down Syndrome (DS) following treatment for Transient Abnormal Myelopoiesis (TAM).
